name: @fhevm/sdk-common-dev
description: Internal helpers shared by the sdk workspace's harnesses. Never published.
//: - Private, never published. Holds helpers that every generation's harness needs.
- Nothing under a `pkg/` may import it: it would ship a specifier no consumer can resolve.
`test:tarball:run` installs the real tarball and fails if that happens.
- version stays 0.0.0: there are no consumers to promise anything to. Dependents pin "0.0.0" exactly.
- `exports` points at TypeScript source, no build step. All consumers are internal tooling run
through node type stripping, tsx or vitest.
- `type: module` is declared here because sdk/package.json has no `type` field to inherit.
